verdict.rationale: Blaxel Jobs are documented as running many AI tasks in parallel through batch processing. They can run scheduled or on demand, scale automatically on serverless infrastructure, and an agent can launch them via the Blaxel skill using prompts. That covers the core of acting on many items at once. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk management of platform resources (e.g., acting on many sandboxes in one call), details on batch input and concurrency controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
